description: Compute bb/100, all-in adjusted placeholders when supported, session variance, standard error, positional results, and showdown/non-showdown outcomes while clearly separating monetary outcomes from strategy quality.
acceptance_criteria: bb/100 uses normalized big-blind units with stake-change handling.
Outcome stats document rake inclusion and currency/bb normalization.
Reports never use short-term winrate as a proxy for decision correctness.

planning.title: Implement outcome and variance statistics separated from decision quality
